subject: MAP & evaluation: request to rebaseline close / risk boarding
messages:
From: Tom Herrera <tom.herrera@acme.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: MAP & evaluation: request to rebaseline close / risk boarding

Soojin / team —

Quick heads-up from our side: procurement has pushed our internal legal review and third-party security checks by two weeks due to an internal audit. That shifts our go-live expectation past the original 12/10 close.

I pulled together a short proposed rebaseline (attached) that preserves the core eval checkpoints but shifts delivery milestones and flags a couple of new risk items (vendor SSO integration and SOC2 evidence timing) that will need priority attention.

Can you confirm who on your side should own the MAP update and whether Redwood can defend the current SLA request if Acme asks for a later acceptance window?

Attachment: proposed_rebaseline_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet — rebaseline dates + owners)

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Herrera
Sr. Program Manager, Acme Corp
Tom.Herrera@acme.com
From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: Tom Herrera <tom.herrera@acme.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP & evaluation: request to rebaseline close / risk boarding

Tom — thank you for the heads-up and the workbook.

High-level reaction: the proposed dates look sane given procurement's audit. We can tolerate a modest shift, but we need to formalize: (1) an updated MAP with milestone owners, (2) a short risk boarding so stakeholders agree on mitigations and SLA expectations, and (3) a single-point escalation flow if legal/SSO remains a blocker.

Proposed next steps from Redwood:
- I will own the MAP refresh and produce a v1 within 48 hours (so, by Fri 11/27 EOD PST).
- Marissa (CC) will maintain the risk register and escalate procurement blockers to our legal ops.
- Ben will prepare an abbreviated SLA fallback note (what we can ship with a late acceptance + temporary guardrails).

Can the Acme team do a 30-minute working session next week to sign off on the MAP and the risk mitigations? I can do 11/30 09:00–09:30 PT or 12/1 10:00–10:30 PT. If you prefer a different slot, tell us and we’ll adjust.

I’ll attach the MAP stub once Marissa and I sync.

—
Soojin Lee
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, Tom Herrera <tom.herrera@acme.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 08:21:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP & evaluation: request to rebaseline close / risk boarding

Adding the first-pass risk notes below (excerpt from our internal register). I pulled these after speaking with Legal Ops and Infra: 

- R-001: SSO integration (Okta) — current ETA: 2 weeks after vendor attestation; Risk: blocking end-to-end acceptance test if not in place. Owner: Acme infra / Redwood integration SME (Ben). Mitigation: schedule parallel acceptance test with stubbed SSO flows; contingency: temporary service accounts with strict logging.
- R-002: SOC2 evidence lag — current ETA: 3 weeks for consolidated artifacts. Risk: procurement may require evidence before final sign-off. Owner: Marissa Cole. Mitigation: provide targeted artifacts (logs, retention policy, SOC2 scope summary) and proffer an audit window; Redwood to offer evidence escrow for procurement review.
- R-003: Contract amendment request for later close window (Procurement) — Risk: changes to pricing/credits if acceptance delayed. Owner: Tom / Acme procurement. Mitigation: execution of a short amendment (covering acceptance window shift + provisional credits).

Attachment: risk_log_excerpt.pdf (PDF — 2 pages, highlights and owner matrix)

I will consolidate these into the MAP v1 and add owners/acceptance gates. Preliminary ask: if Acme is comfortable with the 12/22 acceptance anchor (instead of 12/10), confirm and we’ll lock in the MAP cadence (weekly checkpoints starting 12/6).

On the scheduling front: 12/1 10:00–10:30 PT works for me — I’ll hold that slot.

—
Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Customer Success Ops
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: Tom Herrera <tom.herrera@acme.com>, acme.procurement@acme.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP & evaluation: request to rebaseline close / risk boarding

Thanks all — meeting confirmed for Tue 12/01 10:00 PT (we’ll use the Redwood/Acme shared meeting link). Agenda (15 min): rebaseline confirmation, risk owners + immediate mitigations; (15 min): procurement ask / amendment outline.

Decisions captured here and actions to follow (for the record):
- Acceptance anchor: provisional rebaseline to 2026-12-22 pending procurement amendment (ACME to confirm by 12/3).
- MAP owner: soojin_lee (Redwood) — v1 MAP to be circulated by 12/1 EOD with owners & acceptance gates.
- Risk register owners: marissa_cole (Redundant artifacts + evidence package), ben_carter (integration fallback plan).
- Procurement amendment: Tom to share draft; Redwood will provide the SLA fallback language by 12/2.

I'll attach the MAP v1 link after I publish it; for now, reference the working doc: https://drive.redwood.internal/Shared/ACME/Map_Versions/Proposed_Rebaseline_v1

If procurement confirms a different anchor than 12/22, we will reconvene and iterate — but this gives everyone a stable working target.

Best,
Soojin
